data.name: Manga Hero
data.detailed_description:
Manga Hero is a real-time action RPG inspired by classic manga. Step into the shoes of Hiro, a young hero searching for his missing mangaka father in a magical world formed from the stories he once created.

Fight your way through a series of handcrafted chapters filled with enemies, platforming challenges, and cinematic encounters. Each area represents a different manga-inspired setting, presented with dynamic panel transitions and stylized visual framing that bring the feel of a manga page to life.

Combat in Manga Hero focuses on skill-based action. Instead of traditional character leveling, player progression comes from unlocking new weapons and mastering their unique movesets.

Key Features

Fast-paced Hack-and-Slash Combat
Engage enemies in real-time third-person combat using a variety of melee weapons including baseball bats, greatswords, katanas, and more. Each weapon has its own special attack and second-stage ability that can change the flow of battle.

Skill-Focused Progression
Growth comes from player mastery. Learn enemy patterns, refine your timing, and discover how to use each weapon effectively rather than relying on stat grinding.

Manga-Inspired World
Explore a world presented with stylized manga visuals, cinematic panel transitions, and dramatic framing that recreate the feeling of stepping inside a comic.

Linear Story-Driven Adventure
Travel through a series of chapters featuring story moments, cinematic sequences, combat encounters, platforming sections, and boss fights.

Hub Area Between Chapters
Between missions, return to a central hub where you can interact with NPCs, test newly unlocked weapons, and prepare for the next chapter.

Challenging Boss Battles
Face powerful bosses that test your combat skills and mastery of the weapon system. Boss fights can be replayed for players who want to improve and refine their strategies.

data.short_description: Manga Hero is a love letter to mangas. It is an action RPG set in a world composed of stories inspired by different classic mangas. The protagonist, Hiro, embarks on a journey across this magical land in search of his missing mangaka father.
